column2: A public swimming pool or spa shall be surrounded by a barrier that complies with Sections 305.2.1 through 305.7, except that the top of the barrier where measured on the side of the barrier that faces away from the swimming pool or spa shall be not less than:

column3: 72 inches (1828 mm) above grade for a Class A, B, or D swimming pool or spa;
60 inches (1524 mm) above grade for a Class C or E swimming pool or spa; and
36 inches (914.4 mm) above grade for a wading pool.

column2: Non-public outdoor swimming pool and spa and indoor swimming pools shall be surrounded by a barrier that complies with Sections 305.2.1 through 305.7.
